verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs describe no-code automation. Users can describe a workflow in their own words to create an agent (monday-docs-14, monday-docs-13), schedule automated status updates (monday-docs-21), trigger automations through 2-way sync (monday-docs-31), and connect to thousands of tools with no development needed (monday-docs-38). The 'score deals and send proposals above 80%' example (monday-docs-32) implies multi-step logic, and 'reusable workflow blocks' (monday-docs-44) hint at a block-based workflow builder, but none of this explicitly documents a multi-step trigger→condition→action builder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual multi-step workflow/automation builder (chained triggers, conditions, actions), detail on step limits or branching, and independent or hands-on corroboration that non-technical PMs can build these.
